verdict.rationale: AnyDesk is a remote desktop and remote-support tool, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from plugged-in MCP servers falls outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows an AI assistant or MCP client capability that would make this axis apply. The documented CLI and REST API cover install, session, and account automation only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
